entities.name: Arajik Marutjan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arajik Marutjan is an amateur welterweight boxer who represents Germany. In 2013, he won a bronze medal at the world championships and a silver at the European championships. He was eliminated in the first bout at the 2016 Olympics.
